text: Avadhi is the knowledge with a limited object, which is the cause for the destruction and cessation [of karmas] produced by qualities such as right perception. When the destruction and cessation of the obscuring karmas of jealousy, hindrance, and knowledge-covering have occurred, the knowledge that clearly delineates the object of another's mind is Manaḥ-paryāya. Ascetics perform special austerities for some other purpose; that knowledge which is not mixed with any other knowledge is Kevala.
